snippet.title: PlayStation - Professional Underground League of Pain (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
When society's misfits and renegades banded together to create the sport of the future, they made it brutally simple. No refs. No rules. No penalties. Lots of fighting. Welcome to the Professional Underground League of Pain, where the goal is to charge the plasma ball and shoot it into the hoop, but the fun is making the other team pay for getting in your way!
